violations.text: The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was less than 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 150 ppm. PIC put in service call for dispenser at the time of inspection. PIC will manually fill sanitizer buckets and test until dispenser is serviced. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026

Roast Beef and Bolognese sauce which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Both products were dated for yesterday. Proper cooling methods reviewed with PIC. Product was voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the slicer have an accumulation of food debris. Slicer to be washed rinsed and sanitized prior to use. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2026
The gauge for the dishwasher was broken and not reading PSI. Thermolabel did change color. Gauge to be repaired. New Violation. Correct By: 05/22/2024
